data.title: Canada Goose Presents the Fall/Winter 2026 Collection
data.description: In Toronto, Canada Goose has introduced its latest Fall/Winter 2026 lineup under the vision of Creative Director Haider Ackermann. The collection, overseen and curated by Ackermann, showcases a fusion of pieces from throughout the season, embodying his aim for individuals to approach fall and winter with enthusiasm, positivity, and an appreciation for artisanship. This season emphasizes the use of materials and textures to narrate a tale, along with silhouettes that provoke intrigue upon closer inspection. Ackermann's influence is palpable in the Canada Goose Fall/Winter 2026 collection.

data.title: Momentus Grants Inducement Awards to New Employees
data.description: Momentus Inc., a commercial space company based in San Jose, California, has disclosed the granting of inducement awards to 14 new employees as part of their 2022 Inducement Equity Plan. The company, trading under NASDAQ as MNTS, specializes in providing satellite buses, transportation, and other in-space infrastructure services. The awards were administered in compliance with NASDAQ Listing Rule 5635(c)(4) following approval by Momentus’ Compensation Committee. This initiative was crucial in attracting new talent to the company.

data.title: Northern Discovery Metals Announces Marketing Program
data.description: Northern Discovery Metals Inc., based in Calgary, Alberta, has recently partnered with Nordcore Media LLC to utilize their digital marketing services. The company has agreed to engage Nordcore for an initial period of 30 days, starting on August 24, 2026, or until the budget is depleted. Nordcore Media LLC, located at 30 N Gould St Ste R Sheridan, WY 82801, can be reached via email at jrojas@nordcoremedia.net. Northern Discovery Metals Inc. operates under the CSE ticker symbol NOR.

data.title: SolarMax Technology Receives Nasdaq Notice Regarding Delayed Form 10-Q Filing
data.description: SolarMax Technology, based in Riverside, California, and listed on Nasdaq under the symbol SMXT, recently received a notice from Nasdaq on August 20, 2026. The notice stated that the company is not in compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) due to its failure to file the Form 10-Q for the quarter ending June 30, 2026. According to Nasdaq regulations, SolarMax has until October 19, 2026, to submit a plan to address this issue. If Nasdaq approves the plan, SolarMax may receive an extension of up to 180 days from the due date of the filing, extending the deadline to February 16, 2027.
